header.shareTitle: Share: copy a URL that contains your full org chart

importModal.title: Import
importModal.dropzoneHtml: Drop a JSON file here or click to choose a file.
importModal.corsHelpHtml: Your browser will only allow OrgVisualizr to read JSON from another site if that server sends appropriate CORS headers (for example Access-Control-Allow-Origin) that include this app’s origin. Hosting you control (e.g. GitHub Pages, raw files on the same domain, object storage with CORS rules) can work; many generic “paste” or file hosts block cross-origin requests, so the load may fail with a network error. If that happens, download the file and use the dropzone above, or host the JSON where you can set CORS.

js.savedSuccess:
"{{name}}" was saved in this browser (local storage).

Local storage is only available on this device and browser. To open the same org chart on another computer or phone, use Share and send yourself the copied link (e.g. email or chat), or export JSON and import the file there.
js.shareUnavailable: Compression is not available. Sharing is not possible right now.
js.shareNoData: No org chart data yet. Add content or load JSON first.
js.shareLinkCopied:
The URL was copied to your clipboard.

The link is not just a pointer to OrgVisualizr—it embeds your entire org chart as compressed JSON, plus the selected language. Opening the link loads the same chart.

The URL can get very long. For sensitive content (real employee data), share only over trusted channels.
js.shareCopyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
